description:
A spool of citizen records walked out of Ledger Hall and into the west wastes, which happens, and something has built a nest out of it, which does not.

The Registrar is precise about the problem in a way that takes a moment to land.

"Eleven thousand people," she says. "Not the paper. The people. If that spool goes, they weren't born, they didn't marry, they don't own their rooms. I won't be able to prove they exist and neither will they."

She squares a stack that's already square.

"It has made a bed out of them. Go and take it apart."
name: Paper Trail

objectives.desc: Destroy the slag wight denning on the lost records (deep west wastes)
emotes: {who} follows a trail of shredded municipal paper into somewhere it shouldn't go.
{who} finds the nest, and it's made of names.
{who} kills a thing that has been sleeping on eleven thousand people for a season.
